位置: Obtained automatically when arriving at the Asylum.
内容要点: 匿名举报巨山精神病院与穆克夫公司罪行的信件，开启整个事件。

英文原名: Project Walrider Patient Status Report For William Hope
中文译名: 瓦尔里德计划患者状态报告：威廉·霍普
位置: After climbing through a window you will be in a dark room. After the dark room you need to go through a corridor. Look in the second room on the left to find this document on a desk.
内容要点: 瓦尔里德计划受试者威廉·霍普的治疗与实验状态记录。

位置: After you are being attacked you will fall to the floor below and see a short cutscene. After you stand up there is a desk and some corpses in front of you. The document is on the desk.
内容要点: 关于巨山精神病院资产扣押的法律令状。

英文原名: Project Walrider Patient Status Report For Chris Walker
中文译名: 瓦尔里德计划患者状态报告：克里斯·沃克
位置: After picking up the previous document, go through the dark room to your right. There’s a well-lit chamber in the corner of the room. In there you will find the document.
内容要点: 瓦尔里德计划受试者克里斯·沃克的治疗与实验状态记录。

中文译名: 瓦尔里德计划盈利报告
位置: In the room at the end of the hallway, next to the security room. The document is on a desk in the corner of this room.
内容要点: 穆克夫对瓦尔里德计划进行盈利评估的内部报告。

位置: When you enter the downstairs area where you have to restore the power, you will have to squeeze through a gap (very beginning of downstairs area). Immediately look to your right and you’ll see this document on a desk.
内容要点: 涉及 MKULTRA 项目的催眠与自杀研究摘录。

位置: When you have to follow the trail of blood, you will go through a disinfection chamber and then up some stairs. There’s a guy looking at a bloody wall. To the left side of him is the document (at the end of the corridor in the dark).
内容要点: 关于自称为神父的病人马丁及其行为的记录。

位置: You will come to a point where two naked men are standing behind a locked prison door. You will need to climb out the window to get around them. Once you reach the other side, jump through the broken window of the office room in front of you. There’s a document on the desk in this office.
内容要点: 净化闸门的维护说明与操作备忘。

位置: After going through the Showers, immediately go into the room to your right. This room has two prison cells in it and the document is on a desk near the door.
内容要点: 韦尼克医生的官方死亡证明文件。

位置: After escaping the big monster guy, you will come to a large, well-lit room with many prison cells. Look inside the first prison cell to your right, after making the jump from the ledge (second floor).
内容要点: 韦尼克医生去世消息的讣告。

位置: Shortly after entering the sewers you will have to crawl through a pipe. Once you reach the other side, head left and you’ll find this document in a well-lit area.
内容要点: 以沙为主题的宗教/狂热文本。

位置: This one is a little tricky. You will come to a flooded, completely dark area. It’s literally pitch-black everywhere. Navigate through the flooded area until you see a dead man leaning over the handrail of a catwalk. Take a few more steps to drop down the catwalk. Now on your left you’ll see a well-lit area and in front of you is another broken catwalk. You need to climb up the broken catwalk in front of you and keep going until you find a door. Open it and you’ll see the document on the ground. This is just before you encounter the big monster guy in the flooded area.
内容要点: 描述受害者仍在流血的惨状的文档。

中文译名: 瓦尔里德计划成本报告
位置: After pushing aside the next container, you will come to a hospital room. At the very end of this room, on the right side, is the document.
内容要点: 瓦尔里德计划的成本核算报告。

位置: While you’re on your way to find the elevator key, you will have to crawl through a dark air vent. You enter the air vent after pushing aside the heavy container in the hallway. Once you drop out of the vent, go to the restroom in front of you and open the door on the right side to pick up this document.
内容要点: 工作人员请求调离巨山精神病院的申请。

位置: After you meet the Priest, go into the dark hallway and make a right. You’ll come to a locker room. At the end of the room, in a dark corner, is this document.
内容要点: 关于迫害妄想症状的精神病学资料。

中文译名: 精神病理亲近应激障碍手册
位置: After exiting the burning room, go left before squeezing through the gap. There in the corner of the dark room you will find this document.
内容要点: 介绍精神病理亲近应激障碍的宣传手册。

位置: Before exiting the building (door with red Exit sign), go into the office on the right side. There’s a document on the desk.
内容要点: MKULTRA 项目相关实验内容的摘录。

位置: Can be found outside, in the dark. After you go through the door with the red Exit sign, run in a perfectly straight line until you reach the end of the area. There are some stairs that lead up to the document. Behind it is some bloody writing on the wall that says “how alive are you”.
内容要点: 带有宗教隐喻的院内记录。

位置: After finding the last note you will go through a well-lit room and reach a long, dark corridor. As soon as you enter this long corridor, turn right and go all the way to the end until you find this document under the stairwell.
内容要点: 将瓦尔里德与噩梦联系在一起的记录。

位置: After making it through the long, dark corridor from the last document, you will reach a well-lit room with a broken wheelchair in the middle. There are two stairs: one going up and one going down. For this document you need to go down and look in a corner of the basement.
内容要点: 回形针计划相关内容的摘录。

英文原名: You Promised Me a Rose Garden
位置: After retrieving the key and jumping up the broken stairs, you will come to a point where the floor breaks in. The Walrider Ghost will then appear. Follow it and enter the next room. In the corner of this room, on a bed, is this document.
内容要点: 带有情感与承诺色彩的笔记/文档。

位置: As soon as you enter the “Return to Administration Block” area, the big monster guy will show up in a long corridor in front of you. You need to enter a door on the left and climb up to an air vent. While in the air vent, make a right and explore the hidden side room to discover this document about Billy’s Dreams.
内容要点: 记录比利·霍普梦境与幻觉的文档。

位置: After obtaining the previous document, go back into the air vent and push aside the corpse that is blocking your path. Drop down and you’ll find yourself in front of the library. This document is in the library, on a computer desk.
内容要点: 描述灵魂/精神突破的异常事件记录。

位置: After leaving the theater you will have to go through a corridor. Go to the very end of the corridor into a well-lit room to find this document on some boxes.
内容要点: 关于坏死性筋膜炎病症的医学记录。

位置: In room B329 of the corridor where all the praying patients can be found. It’s shortly after squeezing through a gap in the wall, but before climbing out the window in room B326.
内容要点: 以犹大为主题的宗教/狂热文本。

位置: Same room as Note #24, behind the front desk.
内容要点: 关于智慧之傲慢的哲学/宗教文本。

位置: After you have obtained document #26, leave the room and go through the tunnel. You’ll now enter a hallway with two labs on the left side. The second lab contains the document.
内容要点: 对变异体进行尸检的医学报告。

位置: After your talk with the mad scientist, you will be chased by a ghost. Escape and go through the decontamination chamber upstairs. The document is in the next room you enter, on the front desk.
内容要点: 探讨神明与怪物边界的文档。

中文译名: 形态发生引擎室注意事项
位置: Same room as note #27. The document is on the servers in front of the big orb machine.
内容要点: 形态发生引擎室的安全与操作注意事项。

位置: Same room as note #29. Go up the stairs and look inside the small room, on the desk.
内容要点: 借用现代普罗米修斯隐喻的实验文档。

位置: After going through the decontamination chamber and escaping the Walrider ghost, go up the stairs and you will see the final Outlast Document on the desk in front of you.
内容要点: 批准实验继续进行的许可文件。

位置: After leaving the car, go through the gate and look at the huge Asylum in front of you.
内容要点: 巨山精神病院的外部录像/录音笔记。

位置: After you go through the air vent you will drop down to the library. At the end of the library is a dying soldier on a stick. Look at him and the note will unlock.
内容要点: 迈尔斯进入精神病院后的内心独白/录音笔记。

中文译名: 破碎的人与坏掉的电视
位置: Leave the well-lit chamber from the previous document and go down the hallway. At the end is a room where 3 men stare at a dead tv. Look at them with your camera.
内容要点: 关于破碎的人与坏掉电视的场景记录。

位置: In the restroom next to the security room. Look at the corpse on the toilet.
内容要点: 关于目击者的录音笔记。

位置: After accessing the security computer you are trapped inside the room and have to hide in a locker. Look at the big monster guy when he enters the room.
内容要点: 对高大威胁敌人的惊呼式录音笔记。

位置: After turning on the power and making use of the computer in the security room, you will see another short cutscene. This time you wake up in a padded room. Look at the blood on the right wall that says “Rest in Peace”.
内容要点: 马丁神父牢房内的场景录音。

位置: Shortly after the last note you will have to squeeze through a gap in a wall and then climb up a ledge. There’s a guy in a straitjacket. Just keep standing there and look through your camera to unlock this note.
内容要点: 带有死灵/恋尸主题的录音笔记。

位置: In order to open the door to the showers, you will have to retrieve a key. On your way to the key you will go down a very dark, long hallway and on the left you can see the big monster guy killing another inmate. Look at him with your camera to unlock the note.
内容要点: 关于全面安保状态的录音笔记。

位置: Once you’ve reached the top of the prison block you will have to drop down a hole to move on. You will walk straight into the showers — and there’s blood everywhere. Aim your camera at the bloody “Walrider” writing on the lockers.
内容要点: 淋浴房内血字 WALRIDER 的录像笔记。

位置: Shortly after draining the sewers and escaping the big monster guy, you will enter a room where a disfigured man greets you. Listen to what he has to say.
内容要点: 医生死亡事件的录音笔记。

位置: Shortly after escaping the big monster guy, you will have to squeeze through a gap. On the other side is a sign that says “Male Ward” and at the end of the tunnel is a room filled with corpses. Look inside to unlock the note.
内容要点: 苍蝇围绕尸体的场景录音。

位置: After going up the stairs from where you acquired the last note, is a small container that you need to push aside to crawl through an air vent. The vent will lead you to a torture chamber. Exit the chamber and enter the very dark room on the left. Enable night vision and investigate the writing on the wall.
内容要点: 描述有组织的折磨行为的录音。

位置: After Trager tortured you and cut off your fingers, you will come to a room where another torture victim is lying in a bed. He will scream and Dr. Trager will kill him. Film how he is killed while hiding under a nearby bed and aim the camera directly at the torture victim.
内容要点: 关于瑞克·特雷格医生的录音笔记。

位置: Immediately after Trager is dies in the elevator you need to use your camera and aim it at his head.
内容要点: 特雷格医生死亡场景的录音笔记。

位置: Film the man in the burning cafeteria. He will automatically start talking to you when you pass by. Congrats, you should now have unlocked the “EDUCATED” silver trophy!
内容要点: 关于纵火或焚烧场景的录音笔记。

位置: After activating the sprinklers you need to go back through the room that was previously in flames. Now go to the cafeteria and once you enter, a psychopath will attack. After he is gone, look for a side room in the cafeteria (left side of where you entered). In there is a bottle of fingers that you need to film.
内容要点: 与手指/断指相关的恐怖场景录音。

位置: When you first go outside, your objective is to retrieve a key to open a locked door. After the door is open, keep walking down the dark hallway and a ghost will come to scare you. Keep the camcorder in nightvision mode ready and film the ghost.
内容要点: 黑暗中未知存在的录像笔记。

位置: After escaping the big monster guy, you will have to go through a short tunnel. Now turn right and look for a fountain full of blood and corpses. Film the bloody fountain to unlock this note.
内容要点: 关于庭院水源污染的警告式录音。

位置: Very shortly after entering the female ward you will have to squeeze through a gap and climb through a window. After climbing through the window, a spinning machine will be in front of you (it makes some metallic noise). Get closer to it to unlock the note.
内容要点: 机器中异常声响的录音笔记。

位置: After leaving the dark hallway from document #19, you will come to a very well-lit room with a broken wheelchair in the middle. There’s an elevator in the same room. Inside the elevator is a corpse which you need to film.
内容要点: 表达无处可逃之感的录音笔记。

位置: From where you go the last document, turn around and leave the room. You’ll see the Walrider Ghost again. Follow it and you’ll see a well-lit room on the right side with bloody writing on the wall. Film the bloody writing.
内容要点: 关于谎言与欺骗的录音笔记。

位置: When you enter the theater, a film will start to play. Capture the film with your camera. It takes a minute until the note is unlocked, stay in this area and look at the screen the entire time.
内容要点: 韦尼克医生离职访谈的录音。

位置: After using the key to unlock the closed door, go up the stairs, through the kitchen and you will reach a large dark room with a patient looking out the room. After making your way through this room, you are in a hallway. Enter the first room on the right side to find a praying patient in front of a TV. Film him.
内容要点: 带有静电噪音的祈祷式录音笔记。

位置: Film Father Martin’s Death in the church.
内容要点: 马丁神父受难/殉道场景的录音笔记。

位置: Film the first room of the underground base, after the elevator ride to get this note.
内容要点: 位于巨山之下的地下设施场景录音。

位置: After leaving the hallway from document #26, you will come to a very long tunnel. Enter the first door on the right side to find a secret lab. Film the Morphogenic Formula written on the board.
内容要点: 形态发生公式的相关录音笔记。

位置: Unlocked automatically.
内容要点: 士兵克里斯·沃克死亡场景的录音笔记。

位置: After the room where you picked up document #28, you will come to Wernicke’s Machine. It looks like a gigantic orb. Film it to unlock the note.
内容要点: 韦尼克机器相关的录音笔记。

位置: This is just two meters to the left of document #29. Film the guy in the glas orb.
内容要点: 在生命维持舱中录制比利·霍普的笔记。

位置: After leaving the room where you found note #28, you will go through a tunnel and enter a room with some blue tanks in the middle. Film the tanks for this note.
内容要点: 关于生命维持系统的录音笔记。

位置: After the cutscene where the Walrider Ghosts attacks you, film the bloody life pod where Billy was previously being held to get the final Outlast Note.
内容要点: 比利·霍普死亡场景的录音笔记。
